1.consolidated_definition: Muy grande. Se dice de la persona, ropa o cosa de talla superior a la promedio. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. También hubo variedad de turtlenecks utilizados debajo de jumpers y abrigos oversize sobre trajecitos sencillos (Primera Hora, 08-02-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Extra large. Said of a person, clothing, or item with a size above the average. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Also, there were various turtlenecks worn under oversized jumpers and coats over simple outfits (First Hour, 08-02-06)
